nodes.description: Private mapping tracking token balances of every account; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner => spender => amount, written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token name string, set once in the constructor.
Token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Token decimals, initialized to 18.
External function that loops over recipients/values arrays and pushes _transfer from the caller to each recipient.
Internal transfer routine that debits sender, credits recipient and invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal mint routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances.
Internal routine that writes _allowances[owner][spender].
Public ERC20 transfer wrapper delegating to _transfer.
Public allowance-based transfer delegating to _transfer and _approve.
Public approval entry point delegating to _approve.
Public allowance increase delegating to _approve with SafeMath.add.
Public allowance decrease delegating to _approve with SafeMath.sub.
Deploy-time constructor that mints the fixed initial supply to the deployer.
Internal helper returning msg.sender used as the caller identity throughout the token.
Internal burn routine that debits _balances and decreases _totalSupply.
Attacker-controllable caller identity flowing into _msgSender and transferMany.
Unbounded for-loop over the caller-supplied recipients array performing repeated external-facing transfers.
State update of _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient] performed after the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Arithmetic evaluation of 250 * 10**6 * 10**18 supplying the initial supply for _mint.
Overridable hook invoked before every transfer, mint and burn; external override point.
Caller-supplied array of destination addresses for transferMany.
Caller-supplied array of amounts matching recipients.
Loop counter iterating over recipients and values arrays.
Address debited by _transfer.
Address credited by _transfer.
Token amount moved by _transfer.
Beneficiary address credited during minting.
Spender address receiving allowance in _approve.
Owner address granting allowance in _approve.

edges.reason: recipients array is consumed by the transferMany loop body.
values array is consumed by the transferMany loop body.
loop index i drives the transferMany iteration.
transferMany executes the recipient iteration loop.
transferMany invokes _transfer for each recipient.
each loop iteration passes recipients[i] and values[i] into _transfer.
msg.sender is the untrusted caller returned by _msgSender.
transferMany derives the debited account from the untrusted msg.sender.
transferMany uses _msgSender() as the source account.
_transfer receives _msgSender() as the sender when called from transferMany.
sender parameter selects the debited balance slot.
recipient parameter selects the credited balance slot.
amount parameter determines the transferred quantity.
_transfer performs the balance state update.
_transfer reads and writes _balances.
balance update mutates _balances.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are finalized.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint credits _balances[account].
account parameter selects the mint beneficiary.
amount parameter determines the minted quantity.
constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
constructor arithmetic 250 * 10**6 * 10**18 yields the minted amount.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates allowance deduction to _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
